<!-- FORGE:INVESTIGATOR -->
## Investigation Report

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | CONFIRMED |
| Confidence | HIGH |
| Severity | HIGH |
| Task type | Bug fix |

### What Was Claimed

Issue #94 reports that a structurally valid required local verification policy can name `npm test` at a repository root that has no test script while the real command lives under a monorepo package. The failure is currently discovered only after implementation, and `/forge:init` must not generate an impossible local policy.

### What We Found

The frozen base already contains a safe `cwd` policy field and a static required-command preflight. `preflightRequiredVerificationCommands` resolves the configured directory inside the frozen worktree, checks executable availability, and verifies package-manager script names from `package.json` without executing repository code. `startIssue` invokes it before materializing agents or launching a writer and cleans up the prepared worktree when setup fails.

The remaining setup gap is in `/forge:init`: `configureForgePolicy` always serializes `verification.commands: {}`. It neither preserves valid tracked commands nor statically inspects available package manifests/scripts to select a runnable command. Re-running setup silently discards local checks, while an existing impossible required command is not surfaced during setup. The preflight error for a missing configured directory also lacks a concrete config or `/forge:init` remediation.

### Root Cause

Policy loading and runtime preflight have monorepo-aware directory support, but initialization has no repository-aware verification selection/validation boundary. Initialization overwrites the command map instead of retaining only statically runnable required commands or explicitly selecting CI-only verification. Error construction is inconsistent: all failures include a policy path, but missing-directory failures do not explain how to remediate them.

### Affected Files

| Path | Reason |
| --- | --- |
| `src/ui/commands.ts` | `/forge:init` policy generation currently discards commands and never validates or discovers package scripts. |
| `src/adapters/verification-preflight.ts` | Owns static preflight and remediation diagnostics for command cwd, executables, and package scripts. |
| `src/core/policy.ts` | Defines and validates the repository-relative `verification.commands.*.cwd` contract. |
| `src/workflows/work-on.ts` | Calls preflight before writer launch; behavior must remain fail-closed. |
| `test/adapters/verification-preflight.test.ts` | Existing monorepo regression coverage; add setup/error coverage without executing repository commands. |
| `test/ui/commands.test.ts` | Existing command registration tests; add pure initialization-selection coverage if helpers are exposed. |
| `README.md` | Documents cwd and CI-only policy behavior; update only if initialization behavior changes materially. |

### Evidence

- `.forge/config.json` uses `verification.commands.check` with `argv: ["npm", "run", "check"]`, `cwd: "."`, and `required: true`.
- `src/core/policy.ts` rejects absolute paths, traversal, backslashes, NUL bytes, and normalized paths outside the repository.
- `src/adapters/verification-preflight.ts` uses `realpath`, `stat`, and JSON parsing to check the selected package and script; no command is spawned.
- `src/workflows/work-on.ts` calls preflight after worktree preparation and before `materializeForgeAgents`/`spawnWorkOn`; its catch block removes an unlaunched worktree.
- `src/ui/commands.ts` currently assigns `commands: {}` while serializing the setup result, so a valid existing local command is lost on `/forge:init`.
- Existing tests prove the root-no-script/web-script fixture is rejected for `cwd: "."` and accepted for `cwd: "web"`.

### History Findings

Repository guidance requires deterministic, fail-closed verification and regression tests. README already documents `cwd` and `commands: {}` as CI-only verification, indicating the runtime contract was partially introduced before this issue was fully addressed. There is no `/forge:init` test or package-script discovery helper in the current test suite.

### Recommendation

Keep the current safe cwd and static preflight contract. Add a pure repository-aware initialization step that statically discovers package manifests/scripts, preserves valid configured commands, and otherwise writes an explicit empty command map with a clear CI-only notification/remediation rather than selecting `npm test` blindly. Centralize diagnostic text so missing executables, package directories, package manifests, and scripts all include the exact `.forge/config.json` command path and an actionable `/forge:init` or config fix. Add regression tests for root-without-test/web-with-test initialization and for each fail-closed diagnostic; do not execute package scripts during setup.

### Related Issues

- None identified in the local repository.

### Decomposition Assessment

Single bounded change. The policy, static preflight, initialization helper, tests, and documentation are tightly coupled and can be implemented by one writer without a product or authority decision.

### Acceptance Spec

- [ ] Required verification commands support a validated repository-relative `cwd` and preserve traversal/symlink/control-directory safety.
- [ ] `/forge:init` never selects a package-manager script unless the selected package manifest statically contains that script; valid existing commands remain intact.
- [ ] Initialization and work-on preflight inspect required executables, package directories, manifests, and package scripts without executing repository code.
- [ ] Failures identify the exact tracked config command path and concrete `/forge:init` or config remediation.
- [ ] A root-without-test/web-with-test fixture remains covered.
- [ ] Required checks that pass preflight still fail closed when execution later returns a non-zero result.

<!-- INVESTIGATION:COMPLETE -->

<!-- FORGE:CONTRACT -->
## Builder Contract

### Objective

Make required local verification policy repository-aware during `/forge:init` while preserving the existing fail-closed runtime preflight. A command may be generated or retained only when its executable, package directory, package manifest, and package-manager script can be proven statically from the repository; otherwise setup explicitly uses GitHub-CI-only verification or asks the operator to fix the tracked policy.

### Allowed Paths

- `src/adapters/verification-preflight.ts`
- `src/ui/commands.ts`
- `test/adapters/verification-preflight.test.ts`
- `test/ui/commands.test.ts` (only if initialization-facing assertions are needed)
- `README.md`

### Forbidden Changes

- Do not execute package scripts or arbitrary repository commands during discovery or `/forge:init`.
- Do not weaken `cwd` path validation, symlink containment, executable checks, required-check semantics, or later non-zero verification failure handling.
- Do not alter GitHub, lease, branch, PR, merge, reviewer, or workflow authority.
- Do not add shell wrappers, arbitrary command strings, or untracked/local command names.
- Do not silently retain an impossible required command or silently disable a configured required check without an explicit CI-only choice.
- Do not change unrelated workflow behavior or introduce domain-specific bypasses.

### Invariants

- Every generated command is an argv array with a repository-relative normalized `cwd`, a required flag, and a bounded timeout.
- A generated npm command is selected only for a package manifest whose `scripts` object contains the selected script.
- Existing statically valid commands remain unchanged; invalid required commands are either rebound to one unambiguous matching package or explicitly converted to `commands: {}` after operator choice.
- Work-on preflight still runs against the frozen prepared worktree before any writer is launched.
- Preflight failures include the exact tracked command path and actionable `/forge:init` or config remediation.
- CI-only (`verification.commands: {}`) remains valid and defers authoritative acceptance to parent-owned GitHub CI.

### Deliverables

- Static package-manifest/script discovery with bounded, symlink-safe repository traversal.
- Deterministic initialization selection that prefers a valid root `check`/`test`, then one unambiguous package script, and otherwise reports CI-only mode.
- `/forge:init` wiring that preserves valid commands, repairs an unambiguous monorepo cwd, or requires an explicit CI-only decision for an impossible required policy.
- Consistent preflight diagnostics for missing executable, cwd, package manifest, script, control directory, and symlink escape.
- Monorepo and initialization regression tests plus concise README documentation.

### Acceptance Mapping

| Check | Implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Validated working-directory field | Reuse `normalizeVerificationCommandCwd` and `resolveVerificationCommandDirectory`; generated selections carry normalized relative `cwd`. |
| No impossible `/forge:init` npm command | `discoverPackageScripts` and `selectInitVerificationCommands` inspect package manifests/scripts before generating or rebinding commands. |
| Preflight before writers | Preserve `startIssue` call ordering; improve the shared static preflight and test it without spawning commands. |
| Exact path and remediation | Centralized preflight messages name `.forge/config.json verification.commands.<name>.<field>` and explain `/forge:init`, config, or CI-only fixes. |
| Root/no-test plus `web`/test fixture | Extend `verification-preflight.test.ts` to assert deterministic package-cwd discovery and generated `npm test`. |
| Fail closed after implementation | Leave `forge_verify` result mapping and required review/merge gate untouched; retain tests for static preflight and later execution semantics. |

### Out of Scope

- Automatic execution of tests during setup.
- Parsing arbitrary workspace YAML or executing package-manager metadata commands.
- Selecting multiple ambiguous package scripts without operator configuration.
- Changes to GitHub CI workflows, PR review, merge, close, or cleanup behavior.

<!-- FORGE:CONTEXT -->
## Implementation Context

### Relevant History

- The base already introduced `verification.commands.*.cwd`, static executable/script preflight, and a root-without-test/web-with-test fixture.
- README documents `cwd` and `commands: {}` CI-only mode, but `/forge:init` currently overwrites all local commands with `{}` and has no repository-aware selection.
- Repository guidance requires deterministic authority and regression tests for safety fixes.

### Callers and Data Flow

- `registerForgeCommands` handles `/forge:init` and delegates to `configureForgePolicy`.
- `configureForgePolicy` loads the tracked policy, chooses branches/CI scope/concurrency, serializes `.forge/config.json`, and reports setup status.
- `preflightRequiredVerificationCommands` is called by `ForgeWorkOnController.startIssue` on the prepared frozen worktree before `materializeForgeAgents` or writer spawn.
- `forge_verify` re-resolves the bound command cwd and executes only the trusted argv by name after implementation; this execution path must remain unchanged except for shared diagnostics.

### CI Surface

- Required local verification is the tracked `check` command in this repository (`npm run check`, cwd `.`).
- `npm run check` is the operator-approved named Forge check and will be run only in the verify phase through `forge_verify`.
- GitHub CI runs `npm ci` and `npm run check` on Node 22 and 24; `commands: {}` continues to defer local verification to the parent-owned GitHub gate.

### Prior Findings

- Existing adapter tests cover executable absence, missing package script, missing cwd, control directories, symlink escape, and non-executing preflight.
- No tests cover `/forge:init` preserving valid commands, discovering a unique package script, or explicitly handling ambiguous/no local scripts.

### Hazards

- Recursive manifest discovery must skip runtime/control/dependency trees and symlink directories, remain bounded, and never execute package code.
- Rebinding an invalid existing required command is safe only when exactly one package contains the requested script and the executable remains statically available.
- Falling back to CI-only must not silently erase a required policy; an existing impossible policy requires an explicit operator choice and a remediation message.
- Generated command names and argv must remain compatible with the existing policy parser and bound child runtime.

<!-- FORGE:CONTEXT:COMPLETE -->

<!-- FORGE:ARCHITECT -->
## Implementation Plan

1. Add bounded, symlink-safe static package manifest/script discovery and deterministic command-candidate selection to `verification-preflight.ts`; preserve existing preflight checks and enrich all failure messages with exact-path remediation. (cwd-policy, init-selection, preflight-safety)
2. Wire `configureForgePolicy` to retain valid commands, repair a uniquely matching monorepo package cwd, or ask before writing explicit CI-only verification; surface selected local commands/CI-only mode in the setup notification. (init-selection, diagnostics)
3. Add adapter tests for root-without-test/web-with-test discovery, valid-command preservation, ambiguous fallback, and exact remediation while asserting no command execution. (regression-tests, fail-closed)
4. Add focused command/setup documentation explaining static initialization, package cwd binding, and CI-only fallback. (documentation)
5. Run the required `check` verification through Forge, inspect the complete diff, create the implementation commit, prepare the PR, and obtain the fresh correctness/security panel. (verification, review)
